name: ronin
description: Drive the ronin coding agent from VS Code — run coding tasks and ask about the codebase against a locally-running `ronin serve`.

ronin.serveUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of a locally-running `ronin serve` instance. The extension POSTs to `<serveUrl>/ask`.

ronin.token.markdownDescription: Optional bearer token. `ronin serve` itself is unauthenticated on localhost, but if you front it with a reverse proxy that requires auth, this value is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Leave blank for a plain local `ronin serve`.

ronin.requestTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: How long (in milliseconds) to wait for `ronin serve` to answer before giving up. Coding tasks can take a while; the default is 10 minutes.
